Aspect,Ⓒs.ⒹrUpaM, AkAraH, Akfti f.; ‘a gloomy a(spect)’ vizaRRAkftiH; ‘he had a cheerful a(spect)’ tasya vadanaM harzotPullaM baBO.
Ⓑ
 2 avasTA, daSA; ‘all things wore a different a(spect)’ sarvaM viBinnAvasTAyAmavartata, viparyAsaM yAtaM.
Ⓑ
 3 avasTAnaM; ‘my house has a northerly a(spect)’ udagaBimuKaM me gfhaM.
Ⓑ

Asperse,Ⓒv. t.ⒹaDikzip 6 P, parivad 1 U; See Censure.
Ⓑ
 2 sic 6 P, ukz 1 P.
Ⓝ[Aspers]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹAkzepaH, niMdA &c.

Aspire,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓspfh 10 (with dat.), A-aBi-kAMkz 1 U, Ap desid. (Ipsati) prArT 10 A, aBilaz 1, 4 P.
Ⓝ[Aspir]ing, a., [Aspir]ant, s.ⒶAkAMkzin, aBilAzin, Ipsu; ‘a(spiring) to the throne’ rAjapadABilAzI; ‘a(spiring) to the fame of a poet’ kaviyaSaHprArTI (R. i. 3); janoyamuccEH padalaMGanotsukaH (K. v. 64).
Ⓝ[Aspir]ation,Ⓒs.ⒹspfhA, AkAMkzA, IpsA, aBilAzaH, lAlasA; ‘high a(spiraion)’ mahAkAMkzA; ‘these are, indeed, high a(spiration)s’ dUrArUQAH-dUrADirohiRyaH Kalu etA AkAMkzAH.
